plans.note: Sec 21.1 caps both parties at one month of Fees paid 'without exception', which conflicts with the Excluded Claims in 21.3 and is far below any acceptable floor — primary deviation target. Read 21.2-21.4 for carve-outs and construction language.

Section 20 contains only a broad Customer-gives indemnity (20.1) for 'every claim' relating to use; no Vendor IP/misconduct indemnity appears, and Sec 9.3 references a Section 20.5 that does not exist. Treat as missing Vendor indemnity plus an over-broad Customer indemnity.
Sec 12.4 imposes a 24-month worldwide non-compete on Customer — squarely prohibited. Note it directly contradicts Sec 12.3, which disclaims any such commitment; cite the conflict.
Sec 2.2 (first of two paragraphs numbered 2.2) makes Vendor sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics — deviation. Sec 12.3 disclaims exclusivity; flag the inconsistency and preserve 12.3.
No MFN obligation on Customer appears; Sec 12.3 expressly negates any most-favoured-customer commitment. Likely compliant/absent — confirm nothing in pricing (7.1, 8.3) creates a benchmark duty.
No non-solicit binding Customer located; Sec 12.3 affirmatively preserves hiring via general recruitment and disclaims any no-hire commitment. Verify no personnel restriction hides in Sec 30.1.

Sec 9.4 gives Customer 30-day convenience termination with refund of prepaid Fees and denies Vendor a matching right — favourable, do not flag. Cross-check Sec 2.1's no-termination take-or-pay, which undercuts it (handle under MINCOMMIT).
Sec 8.2 gives a 30-day non-renewal window plus a reminder with deadline extension; Sec 8.3 caps uplift at lesser of CPI and 3% with 90 days' notice. Expect compliant.
New York law and exclusive New York County courts with no arbitration — within the accepted list. Expect compliant; note the escalation step in 28.3.

Sec 24.1 permits Customer affiliate/successor assignment without consent and 24.4 bars Vendor from terminating or repricing on our change of control — favourable. Confirm no conflicting consent gate in 24.3.

Sec 14.1-14.2 give Customer ownership of Customer Data and assigned Deliverables; 14.3/14.4 handle Vendor Technology, joint IP and feedback. Check 15.1's no-model-training limit and the 14.2 payment condition; expect compliant.

Sec 13.1 grants a Customer-only, non-transferable licence revocable at Vendor's sole discretion, excluding Affiliates and contractors — clear deviation. Contrast the compliant perpetual grant in 13.2 and the revocation limits in 13.3.
Sec 22.1-22.3 limit audits to once a year, 30 days' notice, off-site where practicable, Vendor-borne cost with a 5% shortfall shift, and bar system/data access. Expect compliant.

No liquidated damages or penalty payable by Customer identified; 7.3 bars interest on amounts not due and 9.4/27.3 say 'without penalty'. Sec 2.1's take-or-pay is the nearest analogue but is addressed under MINCOMMIT — avoid double-flagging.

Sec 19.2's 15-day Deliverable warranty with no correction or refund obligation thereafter is the deviation; 19.1/19.3 warranties and the 19.4 remedy are otherwise sound. Cross-reference the 15-business-day acceptance period in Sec 6.1.
Sec 18.1 sets CGL, workers' comp, employer's liability, E&O and USD 5M cyber cover for the term plus one year; 18.2 adds certificates and non-limitation. Expect compliant.

Sec 2.1 imposes USD 2M/year take-or-pay for three years 'without reduction or termination rights' — deviation. Note tension with the Sec 9.4 convenience right and the Sec 12.3 disclaimer of minimum-volume commitments.

Sec 11.1 requires immediate cessation of assistance and deletion of Customer Data with no export or migration support — deviation, and it contradicts the compliant return/deletion mechanics in 11.2-11.3. Cite Sec 10.1's transition-period reference.
